traits: Cap up to 15 cm, brownish to buff, funnel-shaped, with coarse dark scales that turn up with age
Spines instead of gills: soft and pale grey, 0.5 to 1.5 cm, browner with age
Stem pale grey or brown, up to 10 cm, sometimes off-centre
Soft, whitish to tan flesh; can be bitter, especially when old
With spruce and fir, often in hills and mountains, sometimes in rings · August to October
safetyNote: Not recommended: the Swiss controllers (VAPKO) list it only as a seasoning, and Wikipedia (en) calls it edible but not recommended: bitter when old, it can upset the gut. Other mushrooms with spines look alike: Sarcodon amarascens (bitter, with a bluish-black stripe) and Hydnellum scabrosum (bitter, turquoise-tinted base).

sources.title: VAPKO, Vereinigung amtlicher Pilzkontrollorgane der Schweiz (2023). Empfehlungsliste (liste des champignons recommandés), version 09.2023.
